title: Linear-time DVB-T2 LDPC encoder via dual-diagonal staircase accumulator
description:
Replace the dense Richardson-Urbanke RREF preprocessing used for DVB-T2 LDPC encoding with the standard linear-time accumulator encoder that exploits the codes' dual-diagonal (IRA) parity structure. This removes a multi-minute, per-process preprocessing cost from the encode path.

## Background

DVB-T2 LDPC codes are Irregular Repeat-Accumulate codes: the parity part of the parity-check matrix is dual-diagonal (a staircase), so the parity bits can be computed directly by accumulation in $O(n)$ time with no matrix inversion.

The current implementation (`crates/gf2-coding/src/ldpc/encoding/richardson_urbanke.rs`) instead takes the generic path: it densifies $H$ and runs a full reduced-row-echelon-form reduction to build a generator matrix. For a Normal frame at rate $1/2$ this is a $32400 \times 64800$ GF(2) RREF (~$10^{12}$ word operations), which takes minutes. `DvbT2Concat` constructs the encoder via `LdpcEncoder::new` (no disk cache), so this cost is paid on every process launch and every resume, once per configuration — currently the dominant wall-clock cost of the AWGN campaign before any frames are simulated.

The standard encoder accumulates information-bit contributions into parity accumulators (using the per-rate address tables already present in the DVB-T2 table data), then applies the staircase pass:

$$
p_0 = s_0, \qquad p_i = s_i \oplus p_{i-1} \quad (1 \le i < m)
$$

where $s_i$ is the accumulated contribution of the information bits to check $i$ and $m = n - k$. The dual-diagonal parity structure is already documented in `crates/gf2-coding/src/ldpc/dvb_t2/builder.rs`.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] For every supported DVB-T2 configuration (Normal and Short frames, all constructible rates), the new encoder produces FECFRAMEs bit-identical to the current RREF-based Richardson-Urbanke encoder on randomized BBFRAMEs (property test over many seeds).
- [ ] [hard] Produced codewords satisfy $H c^{\mathsf{T}} = 0$ for all supported configurations.
- [ ] [hard] The DVB-T2 encode path performs no dense densification and no Gauss/RREF of the parity-check matrix; encoding uses the staircase accumulator. Verifiable by inspection and by the absence of any `rref` / generator-inversion call on the DVB-T2 encode path.
- [ ] [hard] `DvbT2Concat::encode` and the DVB-T2 BICM campaign binary use the new encoder; the existing fast-tier test suite passes unchanged.
- [ ] [aspirational] Encoder construction plus first Normal-frame encode completes in well under 1 s (versus the current multi-minute RREF), measured on the campaign host and recorded in the closing note.

## Notes

- The roundtrip tests in `crates/gf2-coding/src/ldpc/dvb_t2/concat.rs` currently carry `#[ignore = "slow: LdpcEncoder::new for Normal frame takes 2-10 s"]`; these should become fast once the RREF is gone, so re-evaluate their `#[ignore]` markers as part of this work.
- Scope is the DVB-T2 encode path only. The generic Richardson-Urbanke encoder may remain for non-IRA codes; this task changes which encoder DVB-T2 selects, not the generic fallback.
- This work unblocks the DVB-T2 AWGN FER campaign, whose calibration and production runs are currently gated on per-launch encoder preprocessing time.
